body:
Found reviewing B1 (T-291) before release. Unreleased, so no installed client is affected yet.

## Defect

`AuthRepositoryImpl.checkServerProtocol` (android/core/…/AuthRepository.kt) treats every 404 from
`GET /app-version` as a server from before the endpoint, i.e. below the floor, and refuses to sign in.
But a current server answers that same `404 no_app_package` whenever it carries no APK:
`serve_android_apk=False` (the README's recommended setting for every mounted tenant but one), no APK
packaged, or a source checkout (routes/app_version.py). Against such a server:

* a fresh install cannot log in or register ("This server is too old for this app");
* an upgraded install has `serverProtocol = NULL` from the migration, `UpdateChecker` refreshes it only on a
  200, so the first re-login (after a 401, a password change or a logout) asks again, gets the 404 and is
  refused, and the unpushed rows kept under T-257/T-260 can never go out.

The existing test "a server from before app-version existed is refused" passes for any 404 and so locks
the defect in. docs/wire-contract.md contradicts itself: "The client's floor" says a 404 is a pre-endpoint
server, "App package" says a current server without an APK answers 404.

## Fix (additive, compatible with installed 3.1.0 clients, which ignore error bodies)

* Server: the `no_app_package` 404 carries `"protocol": PROTOCOL_VERSION` in its error envelope (extra keys
  are allowed there). Test it. The protocol is a property of the server, not of the app package, so it is
  answered in both cases.
* Android: on a 404 read `protocol` from the body; only a 404 **without** it is a pre-endpoint server and
  refused. Tests: 404 with protocol 3 is accepted (and stored), 404 with protocol 2 refused, 404 without
  refused, plus the existing 200 cases.
* Docs: wire-contract "/app-version" and "The client's floor" say the same thing; error table row for
  `no_app_package` mentions the key.
title: Android refuses every server that serves no APK: the protocol floor reads 404 no_app_package as too old
